import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

class OsintCollector:
    def __init__(self, target):
        self.target = target

    def collect_information(self):
        # Example of a simple web scraping to gather information
        url = f'https://www.google.com/search?q={self.target}'
        response = requests.get(url)
        soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser')
        results = []
        for g in soup.find_all('div', class_='g'):
            anchor = g.find_all('a')[0]
            link = anchor['href']
            title = g.find('h3').text
            item = {
                'link': link,
                'title': title
            }
            results.append(item)
        return results

    response = requests.get(url)

    for email in emails:

    return results

import nmap
from nmap import PortScannerError

def network_recognition(ip_range):
    try:
        nm = nmap.PortScanner()
        nm.scan(hosts=ip_range, arguments='-sn')
        hosts_list = [(host, nm[host]['status']['state']) for host in nm.all_hosts()]
        return hosts_list
    except PortScannerError as e:
        print(f'An error occurred: {e}')
        return None

import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import json

def collect_osint(target):
    # Define the sources to scrape
    linkedin_url = f'https://www.linkedin.com/in/{target}/'
    twitter_url = f'https://twitter.com/{target}'

    # Scrape LinkedIn
    linkedin_response = requests.get(linkedin_url)
    linkedin_soup = BeautifulSoup(linkedin_response.text, 'html.parser')
    linkedin_data = {'source': 'LinkedIn', 'content': linkedin_soup.prettify()}

    # Scrape Twitter
    twitter_response = requests.get(twitter_url)
    twitter_soup = BeautifulSoup(twitter_response.text, 'html.parser')
    twitter_data = {'source': 'Twitter', 'content': twitter_soup.prettify()}

    # Combine data and return as JSON
    osint_data = {'target': target, 'sources': [linkedin_data, twitter_data]}
    return json.dumps(osint_data)

# Example usage

import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

def track_innovations():
    # URL de la source d'information
    url = 'https://www.example.com/innovations'
    
    # Récupération des données
    response = requests.get(url)
    soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser')
    
    # Extraction des informations pertinentes
    innovations = []
    for item in soup.find_all('div', class_='innovation-item'):

        description = item.find('p').text

    # URLs des sites web traitant des innovations en OSINT

    for url in urls:
        response = requests.get(url)

        # Extraction des titres d'articles pertinents

        for article in articles:
            title = article.find('h2').text
            print(title)
